settings.memory.title: Memory
settings.memory.description: Persistent cross-conversation memory storage managed by a background memory sub-agent.
settings.memory.general.title: Memory Settings
settings.memory.enabled.title: Enable Memory
settings.memory.enabled.description: When enabled, the background memory sub-agent automatically extracts and persists memorable information across conversations.
settings.memory.auto_inject.title: Auto-Inject Memory Index
settings.memory.auto_inject.description: At the start of each conversation, inject the memory index. Use memory_search / memory_recall to retrieve contents.
settings.memory.max_index_tokens.title: Max Index Tokens
settings.memory.max_index_tokens.descrip: Maximum token budget used by the auto-injected MEMORY.md index.
settings.street.title: Street
settings.street.description: Async notification queue — automatically delivers sub-agent and background job results to the agent's context.
settings.street.general.title: Street Settings
settings.street.enabled.title: Enable Street
settings.street.enabled.description: When enabled, async work results are automatically collected and injected into the agent's context on the next turn, eliminating the need to poll for status.
settings.street.auto_trigger.title: Auto-Trigger Priority
settings.street.auto_trigger.description: Minimum priority level required to automatically start a new agent turn when a Street notification arrives.
settings.conversation.title: Conversation
settings.conversation.description: Conversation storage and data retention settings.
settings.conversation.storage.title: Storage
settings.conversation.jsonl_backup.title: JSONL Backup
settings.conversation.jsonl_backup.descr: Write a plain-text JSONL backup alongside the primary SQLite (LCM) store. JSONL is more resilient to corruption but adds I/O overhead. Disable for better performance when LCM is the sole source of truth.
settings.lcm.title: LCM (Context Management)
settings.lcm.description: Lossless Context Management — deterministic, engine-driven context compression with lossless retrievability.
settings.lcm.general.title: General
settings.lcm.enabled.title: Enable LCM
settings.lcm.enabled.description: When enabled, conversations are persisted in the LCM immutable store and context tools (lcm_grep, lcm_describe, lcm_expand) are available.
settings.lcm.thresholds.title: Token Thresholds
settings.lcm.thresholds.description: When the active context exceeds the soft threshold, async compaction is triggered. The hard threshold forces blocking compaction.
settings.lcm.soft_token_threshold.title: Soft threshold (tokens)
settings.lcm.soft_token_threshold.descri: Above this, async compaction starts in the background without blocking.
settings.lcm.hard_token_threshold.title: Hard threshold (tokens)
settings.lcm.hard_token_threshold.descri: Above this, the system blocks until enough space is freed.
settings.lcm.large_file_threshold.title: Large file threshold (tokens)
settings.lcm.large_file_threshold.descri: Files exceeding this size are stored as references with exploration summaries instead of being loaded into context.
settings.lcm.compaction.title: Compaction
settings.lcm.compaction.description: Three-Level Escalation protocol: Normal → Aggressive → Deterministic truncation.
settings.lcm.compaction_timeout.title: Compaction timeout (s)
settings.lcm.compaction_timeout.descript: Max time allowed for async compaction before it is considered failed.
settings.lcm.max_compact_block.title: Max compact block size
settings.lcm.max_compact_block.descripti: Maximum number of messages compacted in a single block.
settings.lcm.max_summary_depth.title: Max summary depth
settings.lcm.max_summary_depth.descripti: Maximum DAG depth before forced condensation.
settings.lcm.summarization.title: Summarization Model
settings.lcm.summarization.description: Level 1 and Level 2 compaction use this model. When set to 'default', the utility small model is used.
settings.lcm.summarization_model.title: Summarization model
settings.lcm.summarization_model.descrip: Model used for LLM-powered summarization. Select 'default' to use the utility small model.
settings.lcm.grep_page_size.title: Grep page size
settings.lcm.grep_page_size.description: Number of results returned per lcm_grep call.
settings.lcm.dynamic_thresholds.title: Dynamic Thresholds
settings.lcm.dynamic_thresholds.descript: Automatically compute token thresholds from the active model's context window (soft: 50%, hard: 85%, large file: 10%). Turn off to set manual thresholds.
